caption: The drawing depicts a dress with no body or mannequin inside it. The dress features large, round puffed sleeves that are a light blue color with shading to suggest volume, ending in peach-colored ruffled cuffs. The bodice of the dress is fitted, pale blue at the sides, and features a central panel of an intricate lace or embroidered pattern in gray or white. The neckline is wide and angular, trimmed with the same peach color as the sleeve cuffs. The skirt of the dress is full and long, composed of alternating panels: the center panel is solid pale blue, while the side panels are decorated with a floral pattern of pinkish-peach flowers and green stems on a pale blue background. The hem is decorated with a narrow blue and white ruffle. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there is an illustration of the floral pattern used on the side panels of the dress, consisting of small clustered flowers in peach and green. The background of the drawing is a neutral, beige tone. In the lower right corner, there is handwritten text reading "BROCADE DRESS LATE XIXTH CENTURY CITY OF NY MUSEUM."
title: Brocade Dress
